title: Add My Supplied Voiceover
tests: Tests adding an exact supplied narration to existing footage rather than returning standalone speech or regenerating the video.

exact_text.text: Make mornings easier: prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.
exact_text.read_as: Prepare your clothes, pack your bag, and plan breakfast the night before. Start tomorrow with less stress.

faults.what: The voice-over omits the required opening phrase, “Make mornings easier,” so it does not say the supplied script exactly.

judge.summary: The kitchen-table video has a voice-over and no visible added captions, but the narration omits the required opening phrase.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is the attached kitchen-table video with an audible voice-over, not an audio-only file.
must_haves.why: The output frames show the kitchen-table clip, and the sound report confirms audible speech.

must_haves.item: The narration says the supplied script exactly, without omissions, substitutions, or extra spoken words.
must_haves.why: The supplied transcript starts with “Prepare your clothes” and omits “Make mornings easier.”

must_haves.item: The entire narration is intelligible and finishes before the 10-second video ends.
must_haves.why: The reported speech is intelligibly transcribed, but no speech-end timestamp establishes that it finishes before the video ends.

must_haves.item: The original footage, framing, and sequence remain unchanged.
must_haves.why: The visible subject, kitchen, and framing match the reference, but a single source frame cannot establish that the full footage and sequence are unchanged.

must_haves.item: There is no music or added on-screen text.
must_haves.why: No added on-screen text appears in the supplied frames, but the sound report does not establish whether music is absent.
